task: SPEC-065/T009 blockers: macOS series (NC-3), account rule (RV-16), quota reader (NC-6) and attempt records
decisionChannel: Founder answers to interactive AskUserQuestion prompts in the HAR orchestrator session, 2026-11-03, recorded verbatim. Additive to founder-decisions-20261103.json, which stays as written.

decisions.item: macOS versions the backend accepts (amends NC-3 of 2026-10-31)
decisions.question: NC-3: ¿qué versiones de macOS acepta el backend?

decision.reading: The backend accepts any macOS 27.x[.y] (27\.\d{1,3}(\.\d{1,3})?) instead of 27.0.x only; the self-check is re-run per build and the environment hash binds the exact product version and build. The founder's machine runs 27.2, build 26B123.

decisions.item: Account rule: the dedicated account versus the owner of /dev/console (RV-16)
decisions.question: Para qué se usa todo este montaje? No termino de entenderlo muy bien. Explícamelo con ejemplos y vuelve a preguntarme
decisions.history: The first answer to the prompt about the console-user conflict asked for an explanation with examples; the orchestrator explained and asked again (ADR 0036 decision 12, human decision support), and the re-asked answer is the owner statement above.

decision.reading: The backend stops refusing the owner of /dev/console, because fast user switching makes the dedicated account that owner. It refuses instead: the founder/operator account (identified explicitly and compared by uid), any account in the privileged gids (admin, wheel; already refused) and any uid below 500 (system accounts). The intent is kept: the lab never runs as the founder's own daily account. It fails closed when the operator account is missing, unresolvable or equal to the lab account.

decisions.item: Who reads the usage card and where (closes NC-6-reader of founder-decisions-20261103.json)
decisions.question: ¿aceptas que escribas tú las lecturas de cuota (auto-atestadas)?
decisions.earlierStatement: OK sin problema. Adelante. Guíame bien entonces

decision.reading: The operator reads the usage percentage on claude.ai Usage or on the phone (same Claude account) and types it with the time or 'now', at most 5 minutes fresh. The readings are self-attested.

decisions.item: In-memory attempt-scoped qualification records built by the driver
decisions.question: ¿Aceptas los registros temporales en memoria (no son emisión, NC-9)?

decision.reading: The attempt-scoped records the backend constructor needs live in memory only; they are never written, never count as issuance, and T010 stays founder-only (NC-9).

closes.note: Decision made; the driver already takes operator-typed readings.
